name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
title: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd - 544322 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Acquisition of Hobel Bellows for about INR450 crore (~25% pre-tax EBITDA yield on price, 50%+ margins, INR129 crore revenue) with core utilisation at 50-60%; organic business described only qualitatively.

utilisation.quote: Current capacity utilization is in the 50% to 60% range, which provides sufficient headroom to support growth without requiring additional capex in the near term.

capex.quote: there's only maintenance driven capex that is required. You will not see a very meaningful capex getting added.

triggers.label: Acquisition: Hobel Bellows INR450 cr
triggers.quote: we are pleased to announce the acquisition of Hobel Bellows

triggers.label: Utilisation 50-60%
triggers.quote: Current capacity utilization is in the 50% to 60% range

triggers.label: Next 6 months order book INR65 crore+
triggers.quote: for the next 6 months there's an outstanding order book for INR65 crores plus

guidance.quote: we see a clear pathway to scale the business assuming conservative growth rate of 15% to 17% over the next 3 to 4 years

guidance.value: clear recovery, improved momentum in Q4 FY26
guidance.quote: The company has seen an improvement in business momentum during Q4 FY '26, supported by better demand conditions and healthy order book.
with only customs clearance pending, which we expect to be completed by the end of May

red_flags.label: Customer concentration: two OEM groups ~93% of revenue
red_flags.quote: there are two key OEMs or the OEM groups who contribute close to around 93% of their revenue

red_flags.label: Pre-AS9100, NPCIL qualification ~1 year away; aerospace revenue not yet present
red_flags.quote: currently the company is also not AS9100 certified

red_flags.label: Low utilisation and exit at ~7x EBITDA questioned; succession-driven sale
red_flags.quote: there has not been any succession plan in the business

evasions.quote: I will not be very aggressive in answering this part. We will have to take a cautious stand
we will provide comprehensive updates on the financial performance post our Q4 results
